candidate_generation.candidate_membership_rule: Generate candidates from eligible training two-hop paths and learned rules; exclude training triples.

scoring.assumption: Distinct rule evidence is treated as independent for scoring; related rules can violate this assumption.

baseline.name: maximum supporting-rule confidence
baseline.description: Maximum confidence of any learned rule supporting a candidate; preserves the current baseline scoring.

experimental.name: noisy-OR over distinct supporting rules
experimental.description: For each candidate, combine one confidence per unique (body relation 1, body relation 2, target relation) rule as 1 - product(1 - confidence). Repeated paths for the same rule are stored once.
experimental.assumption: Distinct rule evidence is treated as independent for scoring; related rules can violate this assumption.

evaluation_definition.precision: Unique candidate/validation exact triple matches divided by unique generated candidates.
evaluation_definition.recall: Unique candidate/validation exact triple matches divided by unique known validation triples.
evaluation_definition.ranking_metrics: No ranking improvement is claimed. The current candidate universe is an incomplete, rule-generated subset and is not a defined filtered full-ranking protocol.
evaluation_definition.unmatched_candidates: Unknown truth; not treated as false.
